160: 		} else {

162: 		}

164: 	}
165: 
166: 	if d.Type.Path != "" {
167: 		pb.Add(d.Type.Path)
168: 	}
169: 
170: 	if d.Kind != kinds.KindHome && d.URL != "" {
171: 		pb.Add(paths.FieldsSlash(d.URL)...)
172: 
173: 		if d.Addends != "" {
174: 			pb.Add(d.Addends)
175: 		}
176: 
177: 		hasDot := strings.Contains(d.URL, ".")
178: 		hasSlash := strings.HasSuffix(d.URL, "/")
179: 
180: 		if hasSlash || !hasDot {
181: 			pb.Add(d.Type.BaseName + pb.fullSuffix)
182: 		} else if hasDot {
183: 			pb.fullSuffix = paths.Ext(d.URL)
184: 		}
185: 
186: 		if pb.IsHtmlIndex() {
187: 			pb.linkUpperOffset = 1
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		if d.ForcePrefix {

192: 			// Prepend language prefix if not already set in URL
193: 			if d.PrefixFilePath != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(d.URL, "/"+d.PrefixFilePath) {

195: 			}

197: 			if d.PrefixLink != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(d.URL, "/"+d.PrefixLink) {
198: 				pb.prefixLink = d.PrefixLink
199: 			}
200: 		}
201: 	} else if !kinds.IsBranch(d.Kind) {
202: 		if d.ExpandedPermalink != "" {
203: 			pb.Add(d.ExpandedPermalink)
204: 		} else {
205: 			if dir := d.Path.ContainerDir(); dir != "" {
206: 				pb.Add(dir)
207: 			}
208: 			if d.BaseName != "" {
209: 				pb.Add(d.BaseName)
210: 			} else {
211: 				pb.Add(d.Path.BaseNameNoIdentifier())
212: 			}
213: 		}
214: 
215: 		if d.Addends != "" {
216: 			pb.Add(d.Addends)
217: 		}
218: 
219: 		if pb.isUgly {
220: 			pb.ConcatLast(pb.fullSuffix)
221: 		} else {
222: 			pb.Add(d.Type.BaseName + pb.fullSuffix)
223: 		}
224: 
225: 		if pb.IsHtmlIndex() {
226: 			pb.linkUpperOffset = 1
227: 		}
228: 
229: 		if d.PrefixFilePath != "" {
230: 			pb.prefixPath = d.PrefixFilePath
231: 		}
232: 
233: 		if d.PrefixLink != "" {
234: 			pb.prefixLink = d.PrefixLink
235: 		}
236: 	} else {
237: 		if d.Addends != "" {
238: 			pb.Add(d.Addends)
239: 		}
240: 
241: 		needsBase = needsBase && d.Addends == ""
242: 
243: 		if needsBase || !pb.isUgly {
244: 			pb.Add(d.Type.BaseName + pb.fullSuffix)
245: 		} else {
246: 			pb.ConcatLast(pb.fullSuffix)
247: 		}
248: 
249: 		if pb.IsHtmlIndex() {
250: 			pb.linkUpperOffset = 1
251: 		}
252: 
253: 		if d.PrefixFilePath != "" {
254: 			pb.prefixPath = d.PrefixFilePath
255: 		}
256: 
257: 		if d.PrefixLink != "" {
258: 			pb.prefixLink = d.PrefixLink
259: 		}
260: 	}
261: 
262: 	// if page URL is explicitly set in frontmatter,
263: 	// preserve its value without sanitization
264: 	if d.Kind != kinds.KindPage || d.URL == "" {
265: 		// Note: MakePathSanitized will lower case the path if
266: 		// disablePathToLower isn't set.
267: 		pb.Sanitize()
268: 	}
269: 
270: 	link := pb.Link()
271: 	pagePath := pb.PathFile()
272: 
273: 	tp.TargetFilename = filepath.FromSlash(pagePath)
274: 	if !pb.noSubResources {
275: 		tp.SubResourceBaseTarget = pb.PathDir()
276: 		tp.SubResourceBaseLink = pb.LinkDir()
277: 	}
278: 	if d.URL != "" {
279: 		tp.Link = paths.URLEscape(link)
280: 	} else {
281: 		// This is slightly faster for when we know we don't have any
282: 		// query or scheme etc.
283: 		tp.Link = paths.PathEscape(link)
284: 	}
285: 	if tp.Link == "" {
286: 		tp.Link = "/"
287: 	}
288: 
289: 	return
290: }

part.text:
Fixed. Summary:

**Root cause:** `paths.PathEscape`/`URLEscape` (used in `CreateTargetPaths`) call `url.Parse`, which interprets `#` as a fragment separator — so everything from `#` on was stripped from the generated link (e.g. `/posts/2024/04/newsletter-#4/` became `/posts/2024/04/newsletter-`).

**Fix** (resources/page/page_paths.go:278): escape `#` → `%23` in the built link before it goes through `URLEscape`/`PathEscape`, matching upstream hugo PR #12343. Files still publish with the literal `#` in the filename; `.RelPermalink`/`.Permalink` now correctly yield `/posts/2024/04/newsletter-%234/`.

**Validation** (via the eval container, whose module cache needed a few entries fetched on the host since the container has no network):
- Reproduced the bug first (link truncated), then confirmed the fix with an issue-based integration test plus an upstream-style multi-case test (page titles/filenames containing `#`); both passed, and the temp test files were removed afterward.
- No regressions: `go test ./resources/page/... ./common/paths/... ./helpers/...` and the full `./hugolib/` suite all pass; `gofmt`/`go vet` clean.

Working tree contains only the one-file fix (not committed).
